# PDFTrail

> PDFTrail is a macOS app (with an iOS companion) that converts PDFs to Excel (.xlsx), Word (.docx), Markdown, CSV, and JSON entirely on-device. Born-digital PDFs are read directly from the file's text layer — no OCR guessing; scanned PDFs use on-device OCR with a review step before export. No account, no sign-up, no cloud uploads. Free to try; $24 one-time unlock, no subscription. Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799649606

## Guides

- [PDF to Excel on Mac: 7 Tools Compared Honestly](https://pdftrail.app/blog/best-pdf-to-excel-converter-mac/): The best pdf to excel converter mac depends on your file and who must never see it. Seven routes compared, mine included.
- [Annual Report PDF to Excel: A Guide for Investors](https://pdftrail.app/blog/annual-report-pdf-to-excel/): Convert an annual report PDF to Excel on your Mac and line up several years of filings, without uploading them to a server.
- [Scanned PDF to Excel Mac: OCR Without Uploading](https://pdftrail.app/blog/scanned-pdf-to-excel-mac/): A scanned PDF to Excel mac guide without uploading the file, why OCR can be wrong, and why the app shows the table before export.
- [PDF to Markdown on Mac: A Guide for LLM Workflows](https://pdftrail.app/blog/pdf-to-markdown-mac/): A calm, on-device pdf to markdown mac route for ChatGPT, Claude, and NotebookLM, with tables kept whole and the file never leaving your Mac.
- [PDF to Excel on Mac: The Complete Guide (2026)](https://pdftrail.app/blog/pdf-to-excel-mac/): Every real route from PDF to Excel on a Mac, walked in order, built around the one question that decides which route works.
- [Convert a Scanned Bank Statement to Excel on Mac](https://pdftrail.app/blog/scanned-bank-statement-to-excel-mac/): How to get a scanned bank statement to Excel on your Mac with on-device OCR and a review step before you trust a number.
- [ICICI Bank Statement PDF to Excel on Mac](https://pdftrail.app/blog/icici-bank-statement-pdf-to-excel/): Convert an ICICI bank statement PDF to Excel or CSV on your Mac for GST reconciliation, without uploading the file anywhere.
- [Convert a PDF to Markdown for ChatGPT (No Upload)](https://pdftrail.app/blog/pdf-to-markdown-chatgpt/): Convert a PDF to Markdown for ChatGPT on your Mac, so headings, lists and tables paste cleanly and the file stays off any server.
- [HDFC Bank Statement PDF to Excel on Mac](https://pdftrail.app/blog/hdfc-bank-statement-pdf-to-excel/): Batch an HDFC bank statement PDF to Excel, twelve months at once on your Mac, then check each closing balance opens the next month.
- [Tabula vs PDFTrail: Extract PDF Tables on a Mac](https://pdftrail.app/blog/tabula-alternative-mac/): Looking for a tabula alternative mac users can run on scans and folders, with more export formats than CSV. Here is how PDFTrail compares.
- [SBI Bank Statement PDF to Excel on Mac](https://pdftrail.app/blog/sbi-bank-statement-pdf-to-excel/): Getting an SBI bank statement PDF to Excel on a Mac without uploading it: what the file really contains, four steps, and the two checks I never skip.
- [Excel for Mac Has No From PDF Import: What to Do Instead](https://pdftrail.app/blog/excel-for-mac-import-pdf/): Excel for Mac import PDF: Get Data has no From PDF entry. Why the connector stayed Windows-only, and how to get a PDF table onto a Mac anyway.
- [How to Convert a Bank Statement PDF to Excel on Mac](https://pdftrail.app/blog/convert-bank-statement-pdf-to-excel-mac/): The three real options on a Mac (manual, online converters, on-device conversion), why bank statements should never be uploaded to online converters, and a step-by-step on-device walkthrough.

## News and engine notes

- [Extract Tables from PDF Without Uploading: Why It Matters](https://pdftrail.app/blog/extract-pdf-tables-without-uploading/): How to extract tables from PDF without uploading it. What "upload" means, which files are safe to send, and the local routes that skip the server.
- [Why a PDF Has No Tables (and How We Find Them Anyway)](https://pdftrail.app/blog/how-pdf-table-extraction-works/): How pdf table extraction works: a PDF stores positioned text and lines, never a table, and the engine rebuilds one before you see it.
- [PDFTrail 1.2: Real Excel Tables from Scanned Pages](https://pdftrail.app/blog/pdftrail-1-2/): Release notes — scanned tables exported with page-true structure, OCR inside embedded images, combined Word export fix, 10 free exports per format.
- [Before and After: Teaching Our Engine to Read Bad Scans](https://pdftrail.app/blog/teaching-the-engine-to-read-bad-scans/): How the engine went from inventing 26 phantom tables on noise pages to zero, the fabrication-never-buys-recall rule, and the conversion report that replaces silent page skips.
